+  const put = (x, y, z, b, st) => (st ? g.set(x, y, z, b, st) : g.set(x, y, z, b));
+  const fill = (x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, b, st) => {
+    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) put(x, y, z, b, st);
+  // A straight wall line y0..y1 (x0==x1 or z0==z1); blk(x,y,z) -> [block,state?]; opens = boxes left untouched.
+  const wall = (x0, z0, x1, z1, y0, y1, blk, opens = []) => {
+    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
+      if (opens.some((o) => inb(o, x, y, z))) continue;
+  // Ring of 4 walls of a box with corner boards (axis y) and head plate row(s) (axis along the wall).
+  const ring = (x0, z0, x1, z1, y0, y1, field, corner, plates, opens, skip = {}) => {
+      return typeof field === "function" ? field(x, y, z) : [field];
+    if (!skip.n) wall(x0, z0, x1, z0, y0, y1, blk("x"), opens);
+    if (!skip.s) wall(x0, z1, x1, z1, y0, y1, blk("x"), opens);
+    wall(x0, z0 + 1, x0, z1 - 1, y0, y1, blk("z"), opens);
+    wall(x1, z0 + 1, x1, z1 - 1, y0, y1, blk("z"), opens);
+    for (const x of [2, 9]) { put(x, 1, 17, "bricks"); put(x, 2, 17, "dark_oak_slab", { type: "top" }); }
+    // front pilaster over the party wall
+    // party wall full height to the ridge, x5..6 z9..16
+    // gable triangles front z9 and back z16 (y7..11 narrowing)
+    for (const z of [9, 16]) for (let y = 7; y <= 11; y++) {
+      wall(1 + k, z, 10 - k, z, y, y, () => [W], opens);
+    // partitions z13 (doors x4, x7 y3..4 open)

input.summary:
Shell A for plots 0-3 is in parts/shell_a.mjs: piers/foundations, decks and floors, walls with corner boards and plates, partitions, gables, tower stages, and the P2 and P3 stair flights. make.sh runs clean (1710 blocks placed, no refused writes, no off-palette blocks).
Plot 3's upper storey, cross-gable triangle and tower with belvedere floor, ladder and hatch are built here too. All openings and reserved cells are left as air.
`mcd check` reports no floating blocks. I did not re-run `mcd check` after fixing the plot 1 gable-end orphans, and the walk output printed only room names, so I have no walk verdict. I looked at one render tile (front elevation); it was too small to judge detail.
left: The walk check has no verdict: the grep only returned room names, and rooms can't be reached until fittings add the doors.
Fit reports P2 stair hall, P2 landing, P3 stair hall and P3 upper landing as 'hallway to nowhere'; this should clear once doors and windows are in.
Plot 1's gable ends are walled only from z10 to the back; the galerie bays at z7..9 stay open, so the roof part must close or accept that.
Plot 3 tower: ground interior opens to the stair hall at (44,3,10), and the belvedere south wall is plain birch planks.
The tower room has no wall between it and the upper landing at (44,8,10), and the ladder is checked only by `ladder_run` (support at x43). Fittings and roofs should verify both.
The plan's 45-degree gable fill in plots 0 and 1 may be overwritten by the roof tool; check the gable triangles after roofing.
Fittings must not expect the plan's birch_slab belt at P2 y7; it is already placed as a top slab ring.
I did not tick the elements.md boxes.

waste.what: Wrote a local wall(x0,z0,x1,z1,y0,y1,blockFn,openings) helper and gable triangles (z plane and x plane) because clapboard_wall and gable_infill don't take per-cell block functions, openings or the x plane.
waste.cost: about 40 lines plus working out each wall's opening boxes by hand from plan.md's OPENINGS table
waste.tool: A vocab helper `wall_with_openings(g, line, blockFn, openings)`, and a gable_infill that works in the x plane and skips opening boxes

waste.what: Worked out every opening box (doors, windows, vents, hearth mouths) by hand for 4 houses.
waste.tool: plan.md's OPENINGS table as machine-readable data (openings.json) that shell parts import, so shell and fittings share one source

companions.task: Check the gable-end triangles (plots 0 and 1) and the plot 3 cross gable against the roof tool's output
Verify the stairwell holes, the rails and the tower ladder after fittings add doors, with walk and fit
